description: This is a JavaScript module exporting an asynchronous helper function 'devTryProjectCost' used in development environments to simulate project cost history data. It throws an error if invoked in production and returns mock data with a delay in non-production environments.

methods.name: devTryProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: An async function that simulates fetching project cost history for development and testing purposes, throwing an error in production environments.
